response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (18+ years) polyglot software engineer with staff-level titles, strong software craftsmanship, mentoring credentials, and recent hands-on work with MCP servers and agentic AI infrastructure. However, his AI-specific experience only dates to 2025, falling well short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required, and the resume shows no evidence of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI. He could ramp quickly given his breadth, but he is not a direct match for a staff-level GenAI forward-deployed role today.
strengths: 18+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, embedded, and high-throughput systems
Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling
Proven mentor and educator (workshops, courses, talks) suited to customer-facing technical leadership
concerns: Far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1.5 years of AI work)
No demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM evaluation/observability
Limited evidence of designing AI systems on major cloud platforms or leading customer discovery sessions

key_factors.factor: Deep general engineering seniority and versatility
